name: privpass

scripts.devnet:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d

notes.midnight-sdk: Midnight SDK packages (@midnight-ntwrk/*) are in optionalDependencies. They are only needed for contract deployment and on-chain interaction. The test suite runs without them.
